title: Bound settled federation delivery receipt payloads and their client-visible history
outcome: Bound lifetime growth of retained federation PromptDelivery receipts without discarding deduplication, unknown effects, current handoff identity or journal/session reconciliation evidence. Keep minimal retained identity/outcome where safe and avoid repeating full operation payloads in the client view.
acceptance: Define and implement a bounded or compact representation for settled federation delivery receipts and their client-visible view while retaining unresolved, current and ambiguous receipt evidence.
Tests cover repeat queue/journal recovery after compaction and ensure no duplicate provider handoff, unknown-effect deletion or lost accepted outcome.
